acceptanceCriteria: Each of pool-room, skip, tier-cap and budget fences has a test asserting the held record names that fence and reason.
A test covers next-stage relaunch for every fence kind, each killed by a mutation.
body: Codex round on PR #1198 noted that the RUNNABLE_HELD_IDLE held record is only tested for some fences; pool-room, skip, tier-cap and budget fence recording, and relaunch preserving bypass across all fences, are untested.
title: Test held-record coverage for pool-room, skip, tier-cap and budget fences and relaunch across every fence
